name: D4 Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires admission to a Portuguese higher-education institution or course.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission from a recognised Portuguese institution.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires subsistence funds of at least €920/month (RMMG) for 12 months or the course duration — waived for CPLP nationals (including Brazilians) who provide a termo de responsabilidade instead.
requirements.fix_path: Arrange sufficient funds, or confirm eligibility for the CPLP exemption.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires admission to a Portuguese higher-education institution or course.
This exemption applies to nationals of CPLP member states (including Brazil).
This requires a termo de responsabilidade (declaration of responsibility) instead of standard subsistence proof.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from the Portuguese institution
Proof of subsistence funds, or a termo de responsabilidade for CPLP nationals

outcome.duration_length: duration of the study programme, renewable while enrolled

sources.title: Portal de Vistos - Ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros

notes: CPLP exemption from subsistence proof is a genuinely distinctive feature not present on any UK, German, or Dutch student route — worth surfacing as a real cross-country difference, and consistent with the CPLP preferential treatment pattern that runs through several Portugal routes in this dataset. LIVE PROCESS WATCH: from late 2026, in-country conversion from tourist status to student status is being closed off — applicants are expected to apply from their country of origin going forward, a genuine procedural tightening worth flagging even though it wasn't as fully confirmed as the D1 consular-preauthorization change. switchable_to includes pt_job_seeker_skilled despite that route currently being non-operational (see its own notes) — the link is structurally correct per the statute even though the practical path is blocked pending the Portaria.
